body:
deploy-bot: created tag release/v1.18.0-celeste (commit a1b2c3d4), pushed to origin and mirrors. Target path: staging -> canary. Planned prod change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: quick changelog summary:
```
- serving: faster KV cache checkpointing -> ~8% p99 improvement for short prompts
- runtime: dynamic-batch heuristic to cut cold-start token overhead
- infra: new routing trace spans exported (#4523)
- fix: guard nil pointer in healthcheck under load
```

anya: thanks, nice summary :tada:
anya: kicking off staging canary now — will post early metrics.

matt: note for Dedicated pinning: confirm exact tag string so I can prepare terraform PR.

deploy-bot: Tag verified: release/v1.18.0-celeste (sha a1b2c3d4). Canary routing: 50 sessions -> expected 30m observe.

lina: QA smoke started. p95/p99 steady so far. median bumped slightly at t+6m (0.7s -> 0.85s).

sre-oncall: @lina please paste heatmap/span IDs for the spike, I'll correlate with routing logs.

lina: uploaded snippet: logs/2026-03-20/canary-spike-6m.txt (link).

qa-bot: auto-smoke passed (10m). tests: basic-gen, embeddings-smoke, healthchecks.

matt: holding terraform pin until SRE sign-off. FYI Dedicated customers on reserved pools may need manual migration — call out in release notes.

sre-oncall: checked traces — spike caused by one host GC, mitigated by eviction/cooldown. No rollback required. :thumbsup:

anya: extending canary to 1h, prepping prod rollout doc with rollback steps in ticket.

matt: adding rollback snippets here for quick access:
```
# rollback model-serving to previous revision
kubectl -n rdw rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=42
# or redeploy pinned image
rdwctl deploy --env prod --tag release/v1.17.5
```

lina: will attach QA sign-off checklist to the release ticket after extended canary completes.

deploy-bot: canary extended to 60m. Tag metadata and changelog attached: https://tickets.redwood/release/6789. Will post final summary when done.

david: noted change window. Ops will staff 02:00-04:00 UTC. Who is primary for rollback during the window?

anya: @matt and @sre-oncall primary, I'll be backup.

matt: placing internal-config pin request: model-serving: release/v1.18.0-celeste — will hold until final canary confirmation.

deploy-bot: canary finished (t+65m). Summary: metrics stable, no error-rate regressions, infra traces clean. Tag release/v1.18.0-celeste preserved; changelog committed to release notes.

sre-oncall: final check: metrics steady 30m post-canary. OK to pin and proceed with prod deploy in the scheduled window. :rocket:

anya: thanks everyone — I'll file the prod runbook and ping before 02:00 UTC.

matt: prepping terraform pin PR and smoke playbook.

deploy-bot: release tag creation + changelog announcement complete. /deploy-bot:thread_end
